title: Dataplex: Data Product Insights & Breaking Changes
summary: Dataplex now provides automatically generated insights for data products, including asset descriptions and sample queries. This update also introduces several breaking changes, making certain data documentation and entry group properties read-only.
details: This Dataplex update introduces significant new capabilities for data documentation alongside several breaking changes. Developers can now access richer, automatically generated insights for data products through the new `dataProductResult` field in `GoogleCloudDataplexV1DataDocumentationResult`. This output-only field provides detailed `overview`s, `assetDescriptions` (including asset-specific `overview`s and `resource` identifiers), and `queries` via the newly added `GoogleCloudDataplexV1DataDocumentationResultDataProductResult` and `GoogleCloudDataplexV1DataDocumentationResultDataProductResultAssetDescription` schemas. For batch metadata change requests, the `GoogleCloudDataplexV1RequestBatchMetadataChangeRequest` now supports `deferredValidation`, allowing more flexible validation workflows. Furthermore, the `entryGroupType` in `GoogleCloudDataplexV1Entry` and `type` in `GoogleCloudDataplexV1EntryGroup` have been clarified to support 'context-set' entry groups. Breaking Change Alert: Several properties have been made read-only. If your applications previously attempted to write to these fields, they will now encounter errors and must be updated: `dataProductResult` in `GoogleCloudDataplexV1DataDocumentationResult`, `assetDescriptions`, `overview`, and `queries` in `GoogleCloudDataplexV1DataDocumentationResultDataProductResult`, `overview` and `resource` in `GoogleCloudDataplexV1DataDocumentationResultDataProductResultAssetDescription`, and `entryGroupType` in `GoogleCloudDataplexV1Entry`. Additionally, the `lookupEntryLinks` method's scopes have been refined, with one `dataplex.read-write` scope replaced by `cloud-platform.read-only`, while explicit `dataplex.read-write` and `dataplex.readonly` options were added.
